name: shopware-panelalpha-assets
description: Bridge, written by the PanelAlpha shopware recipe. Shopware's monorepo has no root package.json: its two frontends are npm projects nested at src/Storefront/Resources/app/storefront and src/Administration/Resources/app/administration. HostCompile::runForPhp() only compiles a PHP project's frontend when the ROOT package.json declares a build script, so this file is what makes the engine's own Node stage run at all. It declares no dependencies; the real installs happen inside the two nested projects.
